name: Ponyx
description:
A notch at the top of the screen that expands on hover to show what's playing, the week ahead and your Claude usage limits.

Privacy: to show Claude usage, Ponyx reads Claude Code's sign-in token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json (read-only) and sends it only to api.anthropic.com. If Claude Code isn't signed in, nothing is sent. Synced lyrics are looked up on lrclib.net and can be turned off in preferences.
